name: Label the Parts
description: For structures: the whole and its parts, what each part does, how they connect, a common mix-up, and a check. Built for anatomy, plant parts, machines, cells and maps.
audience: Biology structures, engineering components, parts of a system.

signals.why: your words ask about parts of a structure

slides.guidance: Lesson title for {topic} and a short subtitle that names the class level.
Students will be able to name the parts of {topic} and say what each does.
What {topic} is as a whole, in one sentence, and where it is found.
The parts of {topic}, grouped, with one short line for each.
What the most important parts do, one point each.
Two parts students commonly confuse, and how to tell them apart.

variants.guidance: A classroom meme about {topic}. Pick one format from MEME FORMATS that matches the idea, write captions a {grade} student finds funny and that make the correct idea easier to remember. Kind to students, never about a person.

slides.guidance: Name the part from its function.
Each part and its job, in one line each.
